task_name: Build Two Additional Small Factories on Distant Industrial Road and Produce Wood/Metal

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When the Industrial Buildings icon shows a '2' badge for newly unlocked Small Factories and Wood production is unlocked at Level 2.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Constructing the two new factories on the far northern road keeps their brown pollution radius completely away from the residential neighborhood while tripling raw material output.
preconditions: Northern industrial road connected to the road network
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place both new Small Factories side-by-side at the far right end of the northernmost road, far from all residential zones.

steps.who: Industrial Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: drag two Small Factories onto the far northern road and click the green checkmark for each.
open their production menus and drag Metal into all cztery empty slots.

steps.who: floating Metal on the original Small Factory

steps.briefing: open its production menu and drag Wood logs into both slots.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the new Residential Zone
steps.briefing: drag Metal (3/2) onto the zone to construct the house.
drag Nails into the production slot.
